description: Module tests sharing one temp dir (log rotation, rm) flake under parallel cargo test.
resolution: Give each fixture its own temp dir (atomic counter suffix).

content: Rebuild module tests must never restart or touch the real install: use Rebuild.restart=false, a temp install_dir, and no-op Hooks (default hooks post events and open TextEdit).

description: Module::configure runs twice per reload (modules::reload configures a throwaway instance, then the kept one), so side effects in configure double-install macOS state.
resolution: Install macOS state only on Event::Started, or in configure only once the module has started (see keys/wire.rs).

content: A module's own tests may import crate::modules::<self>::... but never super::super::; check:layers forbids it even inside #[cfg(test)].

description: Tab cannot carry a separate action: Item.tab only makes Tab call the same activate as Enter.
resolution: Put per-row secondary actions in actions()/act() (cmd+K).

content: Defaulting a file path to the baked FLICK_BUILD_SOURCE needs an is_dir check, because a prebuilt app bakes a checkout path that may not exist on the user's machine.

description: A module that implements Drop can't be built with struct update syntax (..X::new(), E0509) in tests.
resolution: Assign fields after construction; fake fn-pointer hooks keep state in thread_local.

content: Module tests must use crate::modules::<self>::... paths, never super::super:: (check:layers rejects it). A test submodule named like a sibling module shadows it through use super::*; import it by full path.

description: A module that turns on when its config table has any key does not fit a config file shared across Macs (dotfiles): [kota] enabled the poller on mbp-server too.
resolution: Per-host overlay config (flick-24e8); keep host-specific tables in per-host files.

name: poll only while a view shows
description: There is no view-closed event (flick-7638). A module polling only while its view shows sets a flag in open(), clears it in items() (root search calls it on every visit), on LauncherOpened, and before pushing another module's view.
A module's own timed-out state merged with dismissed silenced KOTA's final done update and dropped pending-card counts.
resolution: Keep expired and dismissed separate (Note::Expired vs Dismissed); pending KOTA cards have no timeout (PR #40).

content: A module that tells other modules its state through an event (CardsPending, TaskChanged) re-sends it on Event::Reloaded, so a module enabled by reload learns it.
